description: Run resolve_listing on up to 5 listings in one call, e.g. when comparing search results from a marketplace. Example: {listings: [{title: "…", price_jpy: 3000}, {title: "…"}]}. Returns an array in the same order; each element has the same shape as a resolve_listing result (or {error} for that one listing only). For more than 5, split into several calls. For a single listing use resolve_listing.

listings.description: Listings to check (1–5); each takes the same arguments as resolve_listing.

description.description: Part of the listing description. Optional.

price_jpy.description: Listing price in Japanese yen. Optional.

src.description: Traffic-source tag for usage statistics (optional; only the tag and time are logged).

url.description: Listing URL. Optional; not stored and not fetched.

name: resolve_listings_batch
title: Resolve listings (batch)
